title: 82 Disposal of Persons Arrested under IPC Crimes by the Courts 4.2. A total of 60,02,056 persons, including those brought forward from previous year, were under trial during 1983 out of which the cases of 72.6 percent of the total persons under trial remained pending at the end of the year. The highest percentage of pendency under this category was 80.2 for each of the crime heads 'Criminal Breach of Trust' and 'Cheating' and the lowest was in respect of Rape (72.2). The percentage of persons convicted to the total persons in whose cases trials were completed during the year 1983 was 44.2. This percentage was the highest under the crime head 'Thefts' (48.6) followed by 'Criminal Breach of Trust' and 'Counterfeiting' (45.4) each and the lowest under 'Riots' (30.4). The relevant statistics are presented in Table-27.
